headline: Eurozone consumer confidence unexpectedly improves to -16.9 in November
summary: The European Commission's flash consumer confidence indicator for the Eurozone rose by 1.0 point to -16.9 in November, defying analyst forecasts of a deterioration.
why: Eurozone consumer confidence reflects household economic expectations and influences retail sales trends across the 20-nation currency bloc.
why_moved: An unexpected rise in sentiment indicator beat consensus expectations of economic weakness.
